g.text: ILLUSTRATIVE: curve shapes, no real data

text.tspan: the server takes the work anyway
throughput = every request sent to the server
goodput = requests handled without errors, fast enough for the client to use (AWS)
Google's example: healthy at 10,000 QPS, crashing at 11,000 QPS;
dropping to 9,000 QPS will almost certainly not stop the crashes
